people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: Abraham said to his servant, the elder of his house, who ruled over all that he had, “Please put your hand under my thigh.
translations.bsb: So Abraham instructed the chief servant of his household, who managed all he owned, “Place your hand under my thigh,
translations.kjv: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:
